title: Small Spears
description: This resource pack makes the texture of the spear smaller for better visibility
body:
**Small Spears Resource Pack**
Small Spears is a lightweight Minecraft resource pack designed to provide a more refined and proportionate appearance for spear-like items. This pack adjusts selected item textures and models to create a smaller, cleaner visual style while preserving the original gameplay experience and maintaining compatibility with the vanilla aesthetic. Intended for players who prefer subtle visual improvements, Small Spears offers a polished and unobtrusive enhancement to Minecraft’s default presentation.

- No Mods required
